run_download_all_features: run the download script to fetch all smplx, audio, text, and video features from a URL list file
run_download_specific_category: run the download script with --category charades to fetch only charades dataset features from a URL list
run_download_specific_feature: run the download script with --feat smplx to download only SMPLX feature files from a URL list
run_download_filtered_subset: run the download script with --feat audio --category dyadic to download audio files for the dyadic category
run_download_with_progress: run the download script to download filtered URLs with tqdm progress bar and error handling on failure
